scope: Independent visual prototype; all sample records fictional
visual_direction: Unified AMG public entry, activation and client dashboard with graphite, warm orange, light surfaces and consistent operational order, invoice and reward views

production_reference.scope: Visual hierarchy and availability states only; no private records or screenshots copied

browser_verification.result_source: Workflow run for the exact commit, followed by public deployment.json and published-page tests

activation_dialog.input: six numeric characters with one-time-code autocomplete

home_dashboard.desktop_presentation: Graphite AMG hero with an adjacent light operation card, followed by account summary and invoice and reward panels
home_dashboard.mobile_presentation: Single-column hero and operation card with four-item persistent bottom navigation
home_dashboard.overview_alias: Legacy #overview routes to the new home dashboard

order_list.entry: Full active order list, sorted by next unfinished operation
order_list.sorting: Active: next unconfirmed load arrival, otherwise unload arrival, ascending; completed: unload descending
order_list.tracking_presentation: Compact list on the left, one map/detail pane on the right; independent scrolling
order_list.mobile_selector: Short horizontal list with route, client reference and cargo above the independently scrolling detail pane
order_list.company_greeting: Dzień dobry! + fictional company name; centered on desktop
order_list.route_heading: Country and postal code before city
order_list.detail_status_in_header: Actual status once, replacing the preview caption
order_list.desktop_operation_panel: Left of the map; nearest operation, ETA time/date and order window only
order_list.desktop_filters: Above the compact order selector; three equal status controls in one row, including the narrow iPad sidebar
order_list.mobile_operation_panel: Before the map, under prominent cargo information
order_list.card_primary_arrival: One unloading ETA time/date panel only; separate planned arrival removed from the list
order_list.client_order_number_position: Centered in the full card header; status on the left
order_list.open_action: Larger GPS pojazdu button or click anywhere in the full card
order_list.next_operation_strip: Below map and nearest operation; future unload or last-operation notice
order_list.history_presentation: Collapsed details disclosure; five stages and full history remain accessible
order_list.card_layout: Desktop: compact route and cargo with an equally tall adjacent ETA. Phone: route points side by side, cargo across the full width and a short ETA strip underneath.
order_list.active_card_distinction: Stronger outer border, narrow accent and 22px gap between full cards
order_list.gps_action_position: In the desktop card header; below the two-column card body on mobile
order_list.mobile_detail_tools: Filters and search open through a 44px disclosure button, remain keyboard accessible and retain scope across order changes

map_controls.expanded_view: Larger modal map; synchronized zoom, Escape and explicit return restore focus
map_controls.google_maps_link: New tab with fictional latitude/longitude from positionCoordinates; disabled when GPS is missing

mobile_accessibility.invoice_layout: Stacked rows with field labels and preserved table roles
